title: BNCI 2015-010 RSVP P300 dataset
description: EEG recordings from 12 healthy participants operating a gaze-independent rapid serial visual presentation (RSVP) P300 speller. Thirty symbols were presented one at a time at the screen center under three conditions (NoColor 116 ms SOA, Color 116 ms SOA, Color 83 ms SOA), each with calibration, copy-spelling and free-spelling phases. Participants reached a mean online accuracy of 94.8% and a mean spelling rate of 1.43 symbols/min, showing that the speller is suitable for users with impaired oculo-motor control.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with 63 active electrodes (BrainAmp amplifiers, actiCap) at 1000 Hz, referenced to the left mastoid, and downsampled to 200 Hz. Data were low-pass filtered at 40 Hz, baseline corrected, and cleaned of artifacts. Classification used LDA with shrinkage on spatio-temporal features from 5 individually selected time windows. Symbol selection was based on classifier output averaged over 10 sequences.
